auction.office: Barrow County Tax Commissioner (Delinquent Tax Collector)
vital: All tax sale parcels run in the Barrow Journal for four weeks before the sale.
The official site does not publish the sale location, hours, registration or payment terms; confirm with the Tax Commissioner's office before attending.
Excess funds from tax sales are administered with Weissman Excess Funds Management; the claim form and list are linked on the Real Property page.
Georgia law (O.C.G.A. 48-4-40 to 48-4-45) gives the owner 12 months to redeem a non-judicial tax deed by paying the bid plus a 20% premium; this county's pages do not restate it.
